infinite_in_degree.rule: 54 < 72 <= minimum density degree of X_1(95) (Corollary 4.10 with p = 3, limiting newform 95.2.l.a)

sporadic.rule: finitely many points of degree <= 54: 54 < 72 <= minimum density degree of X_1(95) (Corollary 4.10 with p = 3, limiting newform 95.2.l.a)

isolated.rule: finitely many points of degree 54 on X_1(95), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

isolation.method: reduction modulo good primes (upper semicontinuity of h^0)

curve.model: Tate normal form over the residue field: y^2 + (1-c)xy - by = x^3 - bx^2, Q = (0,0)

reference: F. Najman, Isolated and sporadic points on X_1(N) and X_0(N) (2026), https://hexagonmath.org/2611.00884v1, Proposition 7.16 (certificate x1-sporadic/certificates/verify95.m of github.com/F-Najman/isolated_sporadic at revision 88bc530)
notes: Tate normal form of the point of Proposition 7.16 of the paper: the fibre over u = 1 on Sutherland's newer optimized model of X_1(95). Sporadic since delta(X_1(95)) is larger than 54 (Section 7.3 of the paper).
